title: Acoustic Open Mic Music Lab @ West Charleston Library
event_description: Monthly acoustic open mic featuring talented professionals and up-and-coming performers. Welcoming musicians of all levels to perform or enjoy as audience members in a friendly supportive environment.
venue_address: 6301 W Charleston Blvd Las Vegas NV 89146
event_venue_information:
West Charleston Library

Part of the Las Vegas-Clark County Library District this community library hosts free cultural and educational programming including monthly acoustic open mic nights. The Lecture Hall provides an intimate setting for performers and audiences to connect through music.

Other Events

The library offers a variety of free programs including art workshops craft sessions yoga classes and community gatherings making it a vibrant cultural hub in West Las Vegas.

title: Level Up Tuesday Open Mic @ Paradise Place Jamaican Cuisine
event_description: Weekly open mic night with live A-list band backing. Singers welcome to perform favorite songs or enjoy the show. Friendly supportive atmosphere with authentic Jamaican food and drinks available.
venue_address: 6985 W Sahara Ave Suite 119 Las Vegas NV 89117
event_venue_information:
Paradise Place Jamaican Cuisine

Authentic Jamaican restaurant and entertainment venue combining Caribbean cuisine with live music. Known for Tuesday night open mic sessions featuring professional band accompaniment.

Music Events

Weekly Tuesday open mic nights provide platform for local singers and musicians. The venue maintains a welcoming atmosphere for both performers and diners creating a true community gathering space.

Dining

Full menu of traditional Jamaican dishes including jerk chicken curry goat and authentic island specialties complement the musical entertainment.

title: Eclectic Open Mic Showcase @ The Griffin
event_description: Weekly showcase featuring local singer-songwriters and established professional musicians. Acoustic-focused performances in intimate downtown setting. Interested performers should arrive and introduce themselves to host.
event_venue_information:
The Griffin

Historic dive bar in the heart of Fremont Street's arts district. Known for intimate atmosphere rustic decor and signature fireplace creating warm welcoming space for acoustic performers and music lovers.

Music Programming

Regular open mic nights and acoustic music showcases featuring singer-songwriters. The venue's excellent acoustics and cozy setting make it ideal for stripped-down performances and attentive listening.

Atmosphere

Classic downtown Las Vegas dive bar with character and history. Attracts creative community of locals and visitors seeking authentic off-Strip entertainment in relaxed unpretentious environment.

title: Bluegrass & Old-Time Music Jam @ Centennial Hills Active Adult Center
event_description: Weekly bluegrass and old-time music jam session open to all skill levels. Bring your acoustic instruments and join fellow musicians for traditional American roots music.
venue_address: 6601 N Buffalo Dr Las Vegas NV 89131
event_venue_information:
Centennial Hills Active Adult Center

Community center in northwest Las Vegas providing recreational and cultural programming for adults. Hosts regular bluegrass and old-time music jam sessions welcoming musicians of all abilities.

Bluegrass Community

Home to Southern Nevada Bluegrass Music Society jam sessions. The Tuesday morning jams provide opportunity for acoustic musicians to play traditional bluegrass and old-time tunes in supportive informal setting.

Facility

Modern community center with ample space for gatherings. Located in Centennial Hills neighborhood with easy access and parking for participants.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Bass Pro Shops
event_description: Bi-monthly bluegrass jam session on 2nd and 4th Saturdays. Open to all bluegrass musicians and enthusiasts. Informal jam session format with rotating song leaders.
venue_address: 8200 Dean Martin Dr Las Vegas NV 89139
event_venue_information:
Bass Pro Shops

Outdoor recreation retail store that welcomes bluegrass community for regular jam sessions. The store provides gathering space for local musicians to preserve and share traditional American roots music.

Music Community

Bi-monthly bluegrass jams on 2nd and 4th Saturdays attract players of banjo fiddle mandolin guitar and bass. Welcoming environment for both experienced players and those learning the tradition.

Location

Located in southwest Las Vegas near I-15 with ample free parking and accessibility for musicians bringing instruments and equipment.
